name: VIBRATORY SIEVE SHAKER
desc: The INNOLAB INSTRUMENTS INNO-VRSS-250 Vibratory Sieve Shaker is a rugged, high-frequency grading machine engineered for civil engineering, agriculture, and construction material testing labs. It is fitted with an enhanced vertical vibration motor that creates powerful inclined three-dimensional vibrations, allowing it to efficiently sort coarse aggregates, soils, and grains down to 10 microns.
features: Enhanced vertical vibration motor creating 3D inclined shaking
100% corrosion resistant heavy-duty Stainless Steel housing
Holds 1 to 5 standard test sieves (200mm/8-inch diameter)
High Vibrating frequency of 1400 r/min with 1-4 mm amplitude
Supplied complete with clamping device, SS lid & pan, and a programmable timer

specifications.Accessories Supplied: Supporting clamps & Rods, SS Lid & Pan
specifications.Target Applications: Grading of coarse aggregates, heavy soils, grains, industrial raw materials
